title: Policy Rule (v1)
description: A single action-authorization rule. Strict subset of the Tier-1 policy specification (docs/agentic-aiops-platform/policy-specification.md): action_authz domain only, allow/deny outcomes only. Forward-compatible with require_approval and conditions via schema revision.

domain.description: Policy domain. Only action_authz is supported in v1.

description.description: Short human-readable explanation of the rule.

priority.description: Numeric precedence. Higher wins between allow rules; explicit deny always overrides allow.

enabled.description: Whether the rule participates in evaluation.

roles_any.description: Rule matches if the principal holds any of these roles.

actions_any.description: Rule matches if the requested action is one of these.

outcome.description: Decision outcome. require_approval and allow_with_conditions are reserved for a future schema revision.
